components.name: Kit / Page guide
components.description: Every page begins with this shared guide. Override Page, Purpose and Usage. Typography, padding and gaps stay bound to the same variables.

Purpose#74:1.defaultValue: A one-minute film, built from the same components and tokens as the app.

Usage#74:2.defaultValue: Start with the storyboard. Edit masters in Brand, Controls, Recorder, Workspace and Settings. Motion contains eight playable studies. Canvas positions refresh with reflow-canvas.mjs; timing edits refresh with retime-motion.mjs.

components.name: Kit / Frame note
components.description: A purpose and editing note below a frame. Resize its width to match the frame; text and height reflow automatically.

Detail#74:4.defaultValue: What this frame illustrates, where it appears in the film, and what to edit.
